statement: let w := fun p : ℕ => if Nat.Prime p then Real.log (p : ℝ) else 0; ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ K, let n : ℕ := 2^k; let H : ℕ := 2^(k-k/4); ∀ x : ℕ, n ≤ 3*x → 3*x ≤ 2*n → (H:ℝ)/2 ≤ ∑ t ∈ Finset.range H, w (x+t)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-0103 · 每个中心短区间的素数权至少为块长的一半
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0103 · Prime weight exceeds half a block length at every central start

brief.zh: 块长约为 n 的四分之三次方。以一致短区间素数定理为入口，核对半开区间的端点、对数权及对全部 x 有效的共同阈值。
brief.en: Apply a uniform short-interval prime theorem at length of order n to the power 3/4. Transfer to the half-open interval and prime log weight with one threshold for all starts.
